body: The owner, in chat on 6 Nov 2026: 'I did press yes for the notification thing but no notification about download progress. I would have assumed that if I import a playlist it would install in the server from that moment.' It does install from that moment (it did, until a Stop I pressed myself at 21:40 to limit YouTube load, which cancelled the rest and ended it at 24 songs); the notification only exists for the copy to the phone. This item.
